articles.title: Zvyšují se ceny 2GB variant Raspberry Pi 4 a 5

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Mozilla včera vydala Firefox 157 s výrazně přepracovaným uživatelským rozhraním pro desktop i mobilní zařízení. Nový design přináší modernější vzhled, kompaktní režim a širší možnosti přizpůsobení. Rozhovor s Ajitem Varmou, šéfem vývoje Firefoxu, se zaměřuje na to, proč Mozilla redesign považuje za důležitý krok pro budoucnost prohlížeče.
articles.title: Šéf vývoje Firefoxu: nový vzhled nám pomůže cílit na širší skupinu uživatelů

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Projekt OpenMandriva vydal po delší odmlce novou verzi své rolling-release distribuce ROME s označením 26.09. Vývoj podle autorů zkomplikovaly technické problémy, nedostatek času i pokus o sabotáž distribuce. Nové instalační obrazy proto vycházejí až po rozsáhlejším testování, přestože uživatelé této průběžné větve dostávali aktualizované balíčky průběžně.
articles.title: OpenMandriva ROME 26.09 přináší jádro 7.2, LLVM 23 a podporu Snapu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Souběžně s vydáním Firefoxu 157 je tu také e-mailový klient Thunderbird 157. Hlavní novinkou jsou dvě zásady pro firemní nasazení: DisableChat umožňuje zakázat funkci Thunderbird Chat a DisableFileLink vypne službu FileLink pro odesílání velkých příloh. Správci tak mohou klienta lépe přizpůsobit pravidlům ve firmě.
articles.title: Thunderbird 157 usnadňuje správu firmám a vylepšuje podporu OpenPGP

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Společnost Google tvrdí, že operační systém ChromeOS bude i nadále dostávat pravidelné aktualizace a bezpečnostní záplaty až do poloviny roku 2034. Poté budou novější Chromebooky, které splní technické podmínky, moci přejít na nový operační systém Googlebook. Ten je součástí nových počítačů od Googlu, které se brzy dostanou na trh.
articles.title: Aktualizace Chromebooků skončí v roce 2034, některé přejdou na Googlebook OS

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Webový prohlížeč dnes není jen nástrojem pro zobrazování webových stránek, ale také místem, kde se odehrává přihlašování do firemních služeb, práce s citlivými daty a správa aktivních relací. Proto představuje pro útočníky atraktivní cíl. Úspěšný útok navíc nemusí znamenat prolomení hesla – často stačí získat přístup k relaci nebo přimět uživatele, aby sám provedl zdánlivě neškodnou akci.
articles.title: Útočníci míří na prohlížeče, instalují škodlivá rozšíření a kradou relace

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Projekt OpenSSL vydal bezpečnostní aktualizace, které opravují čtrnáct zranitelností napříč implementacemi TLS, DTLS, QUIC, X.509 a kryptografických operací. Nejzávažnější z nich, CVE-2026–84782, se nachází v obsluze opakovaného přenosu zpráv během DTLS handshaku.
articles.title: OpenSSL opravuje kritickou chybu v DTLS umožňující vyzradit obsah paměti

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: libredb)
articles.description: Vyšla verze 0.17.0 LibreDB Studia, webového databázového klienta pod licencí MIT, který si provozujete na vlastním serveru. Na projektu se podílím. Hlavní novinkou je vestavěný MCP server: AI agenti jako Claude Code nebo OpenCode dostanou přístup jen k připojením, která správce výslovně povolí, a přihlašovací údaje k databázím zůstávají na serveru. Ve výchozím nastavení je MCP server vypnutý.
articles.title: LibreDB Studio 0.17.0 zpřístupňuje databáze AI agentům, ale jen pro čtení

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Výzkumníci z VUSec přišli na další způsob, jak vrátit do života Spectre v2. Nový útok se jmenuje Branch Target Reuse a týká se just-in-time (JIT) kompilátorů, tedy mimo jiné i Linuxového cBPF, Oracle GraalVM či JavaScript enginu Mozilla SpiderMonkey. Linux už záplaty má, Oracle zařadil randomizaci pro příslušnou cache, Firefox pracuje na dotažení site isolation.
articles.title: Branch Target Reuse, nový útok typu Spectre v2 cílící na JIT kompilátory

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Distribuce openSUSE Leap 16.1 vydala svého kandidáta na vydání (RC). Nejvýznamnější novinkou v připravované je zavedení nového neměnného režimu. Půjde o první verzí této řady, která nabídne neměnný režim, ve kterém je kořenový souborový systém připojen pouze pro čtení a aktualizace probíhají transakčně, tedy jako celek. Díky tomu lze změny systému bezpečně připravit a v případě problémů se vrátit k předchozímu funkčnímu stavu.
articles.title: openSUSE Leap je možné nainstalovat v neměnném režimu, Leap Micro končí

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Vývojáři Ubuntu povolili aktualizace z verze 24.04 LTS na Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS. Tato verze s kódovým označením Resolute Raccoon představuje první opravené vydání řady Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, které zahrnuje opravy a vylepšení nashromážděná od původního vydání letos na jaře.
articles.title: Uživatelé Ubuntu 24.04 LTS dostávají nabídku aktualizace na Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Microsoft oznámil dostupnost funkce WSL Containers, což je rozšíření systému Windows Subsystem for Linux určené pro práci s linuxovými kontejnery přímo ve Windows. Součástí je příkazový nástroj wslc.exe, který umožňuje kontejnery vytvářet, spouštět a nasazovat. K dispozici je také alias container.exe, takže lze používat známé příkazy z kontejnerového ekosystému.
articles.title: Windows teď mohou spouštět linuxové kontejnery pomocí WSLC

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Mozilla uvolnila Firefox 157 s výrazně přepracovaným vzhledem. Nový design, který se několik měsíců testoval ve vývojové verzi Nightly, nyní dorazil ke všem uživatelům Firefoxu na počítačích i mobilních zařízeních.
articles.title: Firefox 157 dostává nový vzhled, vrací se kompaktní režim

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Kubernetes je dnes nejrozšířenější platformou na hostovaní Docker kontejnerů a je podporován velkými hráči na trhu (Google, Amazon, Microsoft) skrz Cloud Native Computing Foundation. Kuberneres pro provoz používají všechny velikosti firem, od startupu po korporace. Pojďme se naučit jej používat na dvoudenním kurzu Úvod do Kubernetes, který proběhne v naší pražské školicí místnosti ve dnech 5. a 6. října. Školení proběhne pouze online.
articles.title: Naučte se Kubernetes na našem dvoudenním školení

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: bxmtzre)
articles.description: Vytvořil jsem vlastní mailový Klient, který má nativní podporu Proton, PGP, a AI, která sama filtruje spam na základě volně dostupných pravidel. Ta se sama aktualizují každých 12 hodin. V tuto chvíli hledám pro svůj projekt testery.
articles.title: Mailový Klient s podporou pro Proton, PGP a AI

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Vývojáři společnosti Igalia se za přispění Valve aktuálně věnují zlepšení uživatelského zážitku z používání webového prohlížeče Firefox na přenosné konzoli Steam Deck. Zážitek to aktuálně moc velký není, ale co je v plánu nyní na Torontské konferenci XDC 2026 popsal Eri Pazos Pérez z Igalia (viz jeho prezentace na XDC 2026 Toronto).
articles.title: Igalia pracuje s Valve na lepším běhu Firefoxu na Steam Decku

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Implementace běhu starých her využívajících Direct3D verzí 3 až 7 nad API Vulkan je de facto hotova. Projekt ve verzi 2.3 umí vše, co je potřeba, výkon se oproti starším vydáním výrazně zvýšil, opraveno je mnoho chyb a neočekávají se v tomto směru už zásadnější pokroky, a tak se v podstatě přechází do režimu údržby.
articles.title: Projekt D7VK pro běh Direct3D 3-7 her na Vulkanu je víceméně hotov, přechází do režimu údržby

articles.title: Událo se v týdnu 40/2026

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Gravitace za kolaps vlnové funkce nejspíš nemůže. Život mezi fyzikálními konstantami. Výtrysky černých děr sahají daleko za viditelné okraje galaxií.
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Co zabíjí Schrödingerovu kočku?

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Huawei Connect 2026: nová infrastruktura pro AI. Propojí až milion specializovaných procesorů. AI už využívá více než polovina českých velkých podniků. První český fond na transfer technologií AI – do komercionalizace půjde 1,2 mld Kč. Novým cílem útoků je výpočetní výkon umělé inteligence. Tržby z podnikových úložných systémů se meziročně zvýšily o 33,6 %. Útočníci využívají rostoucího zájmu o agentní AI. XPG Mars 980 Blade: PCIe 5.0 disk bez objemného chladiče.
articles.title: Týden na ITBiz: Tržby z podnikových úložných systémů se meziročně zvýšily o 33,6 %

articles.author: Redakce

articles.title: Událo se v týdnu 39/2026

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Život na Marsu by se mohl vyhřívat v dutinách v soli. Helium po velkém třesku: S rekordní přesností určili klíčovou veličinu raného vesmíru. Vytvořili nový porézní diamant, jak ho česky nazvat?
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Hallův jev funguje nejenom kolmo

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: SAP NOW AI Tour Ostrava: Na cestě k autonomnímu podniku. ZEBRA SYSTEMS se mění na ZEBR.AI. Mzdy v IT zpomalily růst, otevřených pozic je méně. SAP NOW 2026: AI má největší potenciál ve výrobě a logistice. Výdaje na zabezpečení AI dosáhnou v roce 2027 výše 4,8 miliardy dolarů. Ransomware udeřil na zdravotnictví, výrobu i IT služby. Unikla citlivá data pacientů. Kód generovaný LLM je stále plný bezpečnostních chyb.
articles.title: Týden na ITBiz: Kód generovaný LLM je stále plný bezpečnostních chyb

articles.title: Událo se v týdnu 38/2026

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Obrovský soubor dat o supernovách zpochybňuje konstantnost temné energie. Mléčná dráha by mohla mít víc satelitních galaxií. Fyzici z FZU sestavili nejmenší QR kód na světě.
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Vysvětlili fyziku třepotavého letu motýlů

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: SanDisk Extreme Portable SSD: Rychlé externí NVMe do deště i prachu. HP představuje nové počítače OmniBook pro příští generaci práce s AI. Fortinet varuje před dopady kvantových útoků na podniky. Acer Vero 16 – notebook navržený s důrazem na opravitelnost a výkon s podporou AI. HPE a Oracle rozšiřují spolupráci v oblasti infrastruktury AI. Bez lidí zůstane polovodičová strategie na papíře.
articles.title: Týden na ITBiz: Bez lidí zůstane polovodičová strategie na papíře

articles.description: Ucelený přehled článků, zpráviček a diskusí za minulých 7 dní.
articles.title: Událo se v týdnu 37/2026

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Šokující chemická vazba mezi 3 atomy thoria. Obrovský soubor dat o supernovách zpochybňuje konstantnost temné energie. Nové způsoby detekce rušení a falšování signálu GNSS. Projekt BESIII stanovil nejpřesnější omezení elektrického dipólového momentu hyperonu lambda. Experiment LUX-ZEPLIN přinesl nadějný výsledek při hledání temné hmoty.
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Grafen s magickým úhlem poskytuje důkaz o nekonvenční supravodivosti

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara

articles.title: Přímý přenos z LinuxDays 2026

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Byla vydána nová verze 0.17.0 programovacího jazyka Zig (Codeberg, Wikipedie). Přispělo 206 vývojářů. Přehled novinek v poznámkách k vydání.
articles.title: Zig 0.17.0

articles.author: AfD 💙
articles.description: Open-source projekt OpenDLSS-NR je 'bitově přesná reimplementace' neuronové rendrovací sítě DLSS 5 od společnosti NVIDIA, jenže pro grafické API Vulkan (DLSS slouží k vylepšování klasickým způsobem vyrendrovaných snímků pomocí lokálních modelů umělé inteligence, a to v reálném čase). Projekt není nijak spojen se společností NVIDIA, je pouze pro OS Windows a natrénované váhy modelu si uživatelé musí obstarat sami. Zdrojový kód je k dispozici na GitHubu, pod licencí MIT s výjimkou pro komponenty třetích stran.
articles.title: OpenDLSS-NR

articles.author: AfD 💙
articles.description:
Společnost Cloudflare představila Clef a Clef-Flash, open-source rozhodovací modely určené pro rychlou a konzistentní klasifikaci vstupů. Na rozdíl od klasických LLM vracejí tyto modely deterministické striktně typované strukturované odpovědi s exaktními pravděpodobnostmi, tedy odpovědi ve stylu přelomového modelu Jev.
Modely jsou postavené na open-weight modelech Qwen čínské společnosti Alibaba Cloud, podporují obrazový vstup, mají kontextové okno 64 tisíc tokenů a lze si je stáhnout pod licencí Apache 2.0 z repozitáře na Hugging Face. Pochopitelně jsou dostupné i prostřednictvím placeného Cloudflare Workers AI, Cloudflare rovněž chystá platformu pro reinforcement learning, kde si zákazníci prý budou moci modely přizpůsobit svým unikátním potřebám.
articles.title: Clef, alternativa k Jev

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Byla vydána beta verze Ubuntu 26.10 s kódovým názvem Stonking Stingray. Přehled novinek v poznámkách k vydání. Dle plánu by Ubuntu 26.10 mělo vyjít 15. října 2026.
articles.title: Ubuntu 26.10 (Stonking Stingray) Beta

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Byla vydána verze 1.99.0 programovacího jazyka Rust (Wikipedie). Podrobnosti v poznámkách k vydání. Vyzkoušet Rust lze například na stránce Rust by Example.
articles.title: Rust 1.99.0

articles.title: OpenSSL Conference 2026

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Eben Upton oznámil další zdražení jednodeskových počítačů Raspberry Pi. Tentokrát 2 GB varianty o 12,50 dolarů. Nově 2 GB Raspberry Pi 4 stojí 67,50 dolarů a 2 GB Raspberry Pi 5 stojí 77,50 dolarů.
articles.title: 2 GB varianty Raspberry Pi dražší o 12,50 dolarů

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: OpenMandriva ROME, tj. průběžně aktualizovaná (rolling) edice linuxové distribuce OpenMandriva, byla vydána ve verzi 26.09. Vedle Flatpaku také s podporou Snapu.
articles.title: OpenMandriva ROME 26.09

articles.author: AfD 💙
articles.description: Edison Design Group po více než 30 letech zveřejnil zdrojový kód svého EDG C/C++ front-endu. Ten proslul širokou podporou standardů C++ a kompatibilitou s dialekty kompilátorů od Microsoftu, GNU, Clangu, Sunu a dokonce i s prehistorickým cfrontem. EDG byl použit například v kompilátoru Intel C++ Classic, kompilátoru NVCC od firmy NVIDIA pro platformu CUDA nebo v našeptávači kódu IntelliSense v produktech společnosti Microsoft. Projekt nyní spravuje organizace The C++ Alliance a kód je dostupný pod licencí Apache 2.0, doplněnou o výjimky projektu LLVM.
articles.title: EDG uvolnil svůj C/C++ front-end jako open-source

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Linaro engineer Vincent Guittot sent out a set of patches on Friday working on scheduling latency improvements, especially when multiple short slice tasks are running concurrently on the same system...
articles.title: Linux Patches Show Promising Results For Lower Latency Of Short Slice Tasks

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Beyond the various local AI agent/chat options not catering to a specific desktop environment, the GNOME desktop has seen Newelle as an AI app catering to GNOME/GTK4. There's now another local AI option for the GNOME desktop with Moose...
articles.title: Moose: GNOME Gains Another Local AI App Option

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: KosmicKrisp is the effort led by LunarG for developing a modern Vulkan-on-Metal driver for Apple systems within Mesa. This modern alternative to MoltenVK continues progressing well and now enjoys Vulkan 1.4 conformance and its performance continues inching closer to that of the native Apple Metal API...
articles.title: KosmicKrisp Now Conformant To Vulkan 1.4, Improving Performance Against Apple's Metal

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: We are nearing the cut-off of new feature material being accepted to DRM-Next ahead of the Linux 7.4 merge window. But this week another round of DRM-Misc changes made it, which included some new hardware support and other last minute items...
articles.title: Linux 7.4 To Support The Raspberry Pi 10-Inch Touch Display 2

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Coming with Sunday's Linux 7.3-rc6 kernel release is support added for the Turtle Beach VelocityOne Race, a high-end $649~700 USD racing wheel and pedal system...
articles.title: Linux 7.3 To Better Support The High-End Turtle Beach VelocityOne Race

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: There is just over one week to go until the much anticipated KDE Plasma 6.8 desktop release. Some last minute fixes continue flowing into Plasma 6.8 as well as early feature work continuing for Plasma 6.9...
articles.title: KDE Plasma 6.8 Now Makes Tiled Windows Fit Together More Nicely

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: We are nearing the point of the Wine 12.0 stable release coming up in early 2027 while for now the Wine 11.xx bi-weekly development releases continue. Out today is Wine 11.19 with a few new features and plenty of fixes...
articles.title: Wine 11.19 Released With Wayland Color Management For Vulkan, DNS Query Caching

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Asahi Linux developer Sven Peter today sent out the pull requests of the Apple SoC Device Tree changes they are ready to upstream for the Linux 7.4 merge window happening later this month. Most notable is the initial Device Tree for Apple systems using the base M4 SoC model as well as for the MacBook Neo with the A18 Pro SoC...
articles.title: Linux 7.4 To Introduce Initial Device Trees For Apple M4, A18 Pro For MacBook Neo

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Sent out on Thursday was the last round of planned Intel Xe kernel driver improvements targeting the upcoming Linux 7.4 cycle. There is one big improvement that is set to benefit Intel discrete GPUs with at least Battlemage benefiting nicely...
articles.title: Intel Ready With A Big Improvement For Battlemage With Linux 7.4

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Ubuntu developer Gianpiero Carpinelli at Canonical has been working on introducing SHA3-256 and SHA3-384 support for Debian's APT packaging tool in preparing for if/when that SHA2 is broken...
articles.title: Ubuntu Working On SHA3 For Debian's APT For If/When SHA2 Is Broken

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: With the AMD Ryzen AI Halo mini PC that launched this summer that focused on local AI, one of the biggest surprises for me when reviewing the unit was finding that the Linux preload wasn't just a stock Ubuntu/Debian OS but rather a customized AMD Linux distribution known as AMD Ryzen AI Developer Platform. Yesterday the newest version of AMD Ryzen AI Developer Platform was released with some nice software updates...
articles.title: AMD Ryzen AI Developer Platform OS Updated With ROCm 10.0, Linux 7.2

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: The newest systemd component being worked on and drafted for an initial pull request is systemd-appd as a new mechanism to centralizing the tracking of user's apps...
articles.title: systemd-appd Out For Review To Centralize Tracking Of User's Apps

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Imagination Tech was at XDC 2026 Toronto this week to talk up their ongoing work around their PowerVR Mesa Vulkan driver (and PVR upstream DRM kernel driver) with this driver continuing to improve, plans for supporting their new Volcanic GPU architecture, and other improvements...
articles.title: Imagination Talks Up Their Open-Source Vulkan Driver, Volcanic Architecture Plans

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: As a follow-up to the news one month ago of Intel Nova Lake P's graphics introducing a new 64-bit GPU mode, the latest driver-side enablement has now landed for Intel's Iris Gallium3D OpenGL driver for supporting efficient 64-bit addressing...
articles.title: Intel Iris Open-Source Driver Now Supports Efficient 64-bit Addressing Mode

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Canonical engineer Richard Scott McNew published a status update surrounding the Rust programming language efforts in the upcoming Ubuntu 26.10 release. Sequoia PGP is being rolled out to Ubuntu Linux and in a future release may end up replacing OpenPGP...
articles.title: Ubuntu's Next Rust Effort May See OpenPGP Replaced By Sequoia PGP

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Apex Compute is the company started in California in 2024 that aims to produce high-efficiency AI accelerators for real-time edge AI inferencing. So far they have an FPGA prototype for licensing and deployment and carries the bold claim of being "20x faster than the NVIDIA Jetson" and at under 10W and one fifth the cost. Making Apex Compute much more interesting to us now is that they are developing an open-source, Mesa-based Vulkan driver for their hardware...
articles.title: Apex Compute Developing Open-Source Mesa Vulkan Driver For Their Hardware

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Coreboot 26.09 released yesterday as the latest quarterly feature release to this open-source software for replacing proprietary BIOS and system firmware on a growing selection of devices...
articles.title: Coreboot 26.09 Released With Framework Laptop 12 Support, AI Review Comment Policy

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: KDE Linux developers have been experimenting with a build of their Linux distribution based on BuildStream to ship as an OS image rather than a set of Arch Linux packages. They are nearing a point soon where they will decide if they will officially ship this BuildStream-based KDE Linux image...
articles.title: KDE Nearing Decision Point On BuildStream-Based KDE Linux

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: As a major disappointment to the open-source community, Siemens has decided to end -- and close-up access -- to the OpenRadioss project as the open-source version opened up by Altair Engineering under the GNU AGPL License back in 2022. This was an open-source version of the industry-leading finite element solver that Altair developed. Siemens acquired Altair Engineering last year and have now completely shut the door on OpenRadioss...
articles.title: Siemens Slams The Door Shut On Promising Open-Source Radioss Project

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Steam on Linux use in March hit an all-time high of around 5.33% marketshare. Since then it pulled back to around 4% while for September 2026 the Steam Survey results are now in and it's clocking in just above 3%...
articles.title: Steam On Linux Dives Down To 3.05% For September

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: While there have been a number of Ubuntu 26.10 development benchmarks in recent weeks and more on the way, some Phoronix readers have asked about the lack of any early Fedora 45 tests given its recent beta. For good reason, it's largely boring but here are some to illustrate.
articles.title: Fedora 45 Beta Performance: The Satisfyingly Boring Benchmarks

Now five years later the poorly maintained code is removed from the Mesa codebase...
articles.title: Mesa Drops Its Poorly Maintained & Rarely Used Direct3D 10 User-Mode Driver

articles.author: Michael Larabel

articles.title: Ubuntu 26.10 Beta Released With Linux 7.3 Kernel, GNOME 51 Desktop

A lot of exciting happenings both on the hardware and software fronts while October is sure to be another interesting month with the releases of Ubuntu 26.10, Fedora 45, and some more hardware fun...
articles.title: Nearing A 10 Second Kernel Build, Xeon 600 & Other September Excitement On Phoronix

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: With the vast array of wired and wireless networking drivers within the Linux kernel and range of protocols and other networking features, it's a big expanse of code for AI/LLM agents to analyze and critique. The Linux networking developers have acknowledged being "complete overwhelmed" by the AI/LLM-driven patch activity and bug reports as well as battling against AI slop patches. Even though Linux 7.3 stable won't be out for another three weeks, some networking fixes are already being diverted to the next kernel version...
articles.title: Some Networking Fixes Being Diverted To Linux 7.4, AI/LLM Activity Still Increasing

articles.description: Following yesterday's release of the Qt 6.12 LTS toolkit, The Qt Group today released Qt Creator 21 in beta form as the latest version of their integrated development environment focused on C/C++ as well as Python, JavaScript, and other programming languages...
articles.title: Qt Creator 21 IDE Beta Enables More AI Functionality By Default

articles.description: In addition to the very nice AMDGPU IOMMU optimization for iGPUs set to debut in the Linux 7.4 kernel, over on the AMD EPYC server side for servers running SEV-SNP virtual machines is a separate, nice optimization also expected for this next kernel version...
articles.title: AMD RMPOPT Optimization Queued Ahead Of Linux 7.4

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Longtime ARM Linux maintainer Arnd Bergmann over the past year has been working to clear out a number of old ARM platforms from the mainline kernel tree. With Linux 7.3 many older 32-bit ARM platforms were deprecated and in turn hundreds of kernel drivers orphaned. Now it's on to removing that actual code, which given the amount of entangled code, is itself a challenge...
articles.title: Clearing Out Linux's Old 32-bit ARM Platform Code Is Itself A Challenge

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Earlier this year Intel announced the "Optimization Zone" as their new initiative to provide a centralized place to collect all their resources for maximizing performance and software tuning on Intel hardware platforms. They've continued building out more resources for the Intel Optimization Zone and yesterday released v1.2 with more tuning guides and best practices for optimal performance on Intel hardware...
articles.title: Intel Optimization Zone 1.2 Released With New Guides & Recommendations

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Back in August I wrote about NVIDIA working on Linux scheduler improvements for helping the SMT performance on their new Vera CPU with Olympus cores. That work remains ongoing but is looking fairly beneficial for performance especially for knocking it out in less than one hundred lines of code...
articles.title: NVIDIA Olympus SMT Optimizations For Vera CPU Showing 3~6% Performance Gains

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Rob Clark, who originally started working on the reverse-engineering Freedreno and MSM DRM graphics driver projects prior to even being employed by Qualcomm, presented this week at XDC 2026 Toronto around all the recent efforts they have been pursuing at Qualcomm for this upstream open-source graphics driver stack...
articles.title: Qualcomm Continues Doing More For Their Open-Source Linux Graphics Drivers

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
An alleged operator of pirate IPTV services Kemo IPTV and Lemo TV faces criminal prosecution in Dubai, following a complaint from anti-piracy coalition ACE. The case surprisingly surfaced in a Florida federal court, where DISH Network's request for a $28.65 million default judgment against the same defendants was just denied. According to the judge, DISH failed to show that they were properly served.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Alleged Kemo IPTV Operator Faces Criminal Prosecution in Dubai Following ACE Complaint

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Months after a Spanish court refused to fine NordVPN over IP blocking, LaLiga is now raising its concerns with the European Commission. The football league has asked the EU to add four major VPN providers to its Piracy Watch List, arguing that third-party affiliate marketing guides on how to bypass blockades or circumvent geo-blocking restrictions turn the providers into more than "neutral technical intermediaries." 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: LaLiga Wants Major VPNs on EU Piracy Watch List Over Affiliate Marketing

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Music industry group IFPI has asked the European Commission to add the popular open source YouTube download tool yt-dlp to its Counterfeit and Piracy Watch List. The submission names four of the project's developers by their GitHub handles and describes the software as a major problem for the music industry. What IFPI wants done about the software, however, isn't mentioned.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: IFPI Wants Open Source YouTube Downloader yt-dlp on EU Piracy Watch List

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Senator Thom Tillis and Rep. Zoe Lofgren have introduced their joint site blocking bill, the DEFEND IP Act. The proposal comes less than two weeks after Rep. Darrell Issa's competing proposal, and both bills allow rightsholders to obtain court orders requiring ISPs and large DNS resolvers to block foreign pirate sites. A crucial difference is that the unified bill explicitly leaves VPN providers out.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Unified U.S. Site Blocking Bill Targets ISPs and DNS Resolvers But Spares VPNs

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Every week we take a close look at the most pirated movies on torrent sites. What are pirates downloading? 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' tops the chart, followed by 'The End of Oak Street.' 'Coyote vs. Acme' completes the top three.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Top 10 Most Pirated Movies of The Week – 09/28/2026

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A Washington federal court has ordered former r/SwitchPirates moderator James 'Archbox' Williams to pay Nintendo $4.5 million in damages. The default judgment includes a permanent injunction that prohibits Williams from distributing pirated games and circumvention tools, or encouraging others to use them. Whether Nintendo will be able to recoup the damages is unclear, as Williams never answered the allegations.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Nintendo Wins $4.5 Million Judgment Against r/SwitchPirates Mod ‘Archbox’

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
China's biggest streaming companies are using U.S. courts to take down pirate sites, and a Florida judge just made that path easier. Overruling a magistrate's recommendation, the court ruled that the Chinese-language pirate site Olevod, which is run by a Spanish company, must answer Tencent's lawsuit in Florida. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate Site Must Face Chinese Streaming Giant Tencent in U.S. Court, Judge Rules

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
ACE has announced the shutdown of LiveNetTV, a free IPTV app that survived for a decade despite legal pressure from multiple sides. Two Turkey-based operators settled with ACE. They handed over ten domain names and issued a public mea culpa. The app itself had been dead since Istanbul police raided its operators in February.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate IPTV App LiveNetTV Shut Down After Turkish Police Raid, Operators Settle With ACE

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
VPN providers with over 100,000 American users could be ordered to block pirate sites under the bill Rep. Darrell Issa introduced last week. The full text shows that VPNs were added after last year's discussion draft, which only mentioned ISPs and DNS resolvers. How a VPN should block access "from the United States" remains an open question, as the technical implementation is not defined.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: U.S. Site Blocking Bill Adds VPNs to the List of Blocking Intermediaries

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
At a global film summit in France, regulators and rightsholders praised site-blocking successes, but they also faced unexpected pushback from one of the panelists. South Africa's culture minister accused the film industry of a double standard on piracy, demanding a partnership of equals rather than external mandates.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: South African Minister Tells Film Summit It Has a Double Standard on Piracy

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Google, Cloudflare, and Cisco lost a key challenge against a Belgian DNS blocking order. The revised injunction, obtained by sports rightsholder DAZN, requires alternative resolvers to block pirate sports streaming domains on match days. Cisco says it will suspend OpenDNS in Belgium rather than comply, and intends to appeal.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Court Upholds Belgian Pirate DNS Blocking Order, OpenDNS Exit Looms

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Anti-piracy outfit Denuvo has filed a DMCA anti-circumvention lawsuit in a U.S. federal court, targeting the anonymous game cracker known as 'voices38.' The defendant stands accused of bypassing Denuvo's digital locks on more than two dozen games, including Hogwarts Legacy and Black Myth: Wukong. As the case moves forward, the company will likely subpoena Reddit, Discord, and Valve for the cracker's identifying information.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Denuvo Sues Game Cracker ‘voices38’ for Bypassing its Anti-Tamper DRM

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
U.S. Representative Darrell Issa has officially introduced a new bill that aims to block foreign pirate sites in the United States. While the final text has yet to be published, an early draft suggests that both ISPs and DNS resolvers will be covered. The bill has already triggered opposition, while there is also internal competition from competing site blocking efforts on the Hill.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Rep. Issa Files Competing U.S. Pirate Site Blocking Bill

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The person who sued PassThePopcorn, BroadcasTheNet, HDBits, and three other private trackers has voluntarily dropped the case, but it's not over yet. Through their attorneys, some of the alleged tracker operators want to uncover the identity of the man who allegedly impersonated a Canadian filmmaker. At a recent hearing, defense counsel offered a theory of motive: a former tracker user who was banned after selling or trading invites.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Accused Impostor in Private Tracker Lawsuit Driven by Revenge, Defense Says

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Meta previously argued that uploading pirated books to other BitTorrent users was an unavoidable side effect of downloading them, and therefore fair use. Rightsholders suing Meta in three related cases tried to dismantle this theory by asking OpenAI and Anthropic to reveal how they torrented shadow library data. A magistrate judge denied the request, but that's not the end of the torrenting dispute. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Rightsholders Can’t Use OpenAI and Anthropic to Dismantle Meta’s Seeding Defense

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Six months after Vietnamese police shut down the country's notorious pirate football streaming network 'Xoi Lac TV', investigators have recommended criminal charges against 74 people. While pirated streams drew millions of people to the sites, the operators face the most severe prison sentences for generating millions of dollars through illegal gambling ads.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: As U.S. Trade Pressure Mounts, Vietnam Prepares to Prosecute 74 ‘Xoi Lac’ Sports Pirates

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A new report released by the Digital Citizens Alliance warns that pirate IPTV services are giving terrorist organizations a back door into American homes. By highlighting the availability of Hezbollah and Hamas channels via these services, the group reframes piracy as a national security threat, while offering U.S. site-blocking legislation as a potential solution.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Report Links Pirate IPTV to Hezbollah TV, Calls for U.S. Site-Blocking

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
TelevisaUnivision has asked a Florida federal judge to enter a $32.7 million default judgment against the operators of three pirate IPTV services, who all failed to appear in court. The proposed permanent blocking injunction expands its already-broad predecessor, letting the broadcaster add new defendants without a judge's sign-off.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate IPTV Operators Face $32.7 Million Judgment and Self-Expanding Blocking Injunction

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The copyright lawsuit targeting PassThePopcorn, BroadcasTheNet, HDBits, and three other major private trackers has taken a bizarre turn. After a Canadian filmmaker filed a sworn declaration confirming he has nothing to do with the case, the plaintiff argues there are simply two filmmakers with the same name, who coincidentally created movies with the exact same titles.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Private Torrent Tracker Lawsuit Takes Bizarre Turn: ‘I’m a Different Matthew Schneider’ (Updated)

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (alexbevi)
articles.description:
The ScummVM Team is pleased to announce that Harvester is ready for public testing!
You wake up in the small Texas farming town of Harvest. Who are you? How did you get here? Why does it seem to be the 1950s? What’s the Order of the Harvest Moon?
Harvester is an adventure/horror game, full of quirky characters, campy FMV cutscenes, B-list acting, real-time combat sequences and all the pixel-hunting goodness the genre is known for. Engage with the citizens of Harvest and uncover the town’s secrets as you attempt to gain access to the Lodge to uncover the truth.
For this testing period, ScummVM supports the English, French and European versions. Once you’ve obtained a supported version, see the wiki for guidance on extracting the necessary data files.
Harvester depicts scenes of graphic violence, sex and gore, and may not be everyone’s cup of tea. If you’re not put off by this and want to help us test the games, start by grabbing a daily build and get playing! Don’t forget to read through our testing guidelines, and please take some screenshots along the way.
>
articles.title: You always were a kidder, Steve

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (moralrecordings)
articles.description:
The ScummVM Team is pleased to announce that The Fool's Errand is ready for public testing!
The Fool's Errand is a critically-acclaimed narrative puzzle game based on characters and arcana from the tarot. Help the Fool as he uncovers the lost fourteen treasures of the world, averts all-out war between the four kingdoms, and defies the wrath of the evil High Priestess. Each puzzle solved reveals a new piece of the story, and builds to an overarching metapuzzle that ties all of the threads together.
For this testing period, ScummVM supports the original Macintosh edition of the game - the ports for DOS, Amiga and Atari use a different engine and are not covered by this announcement. All known versions of the Macintosh edition should be supported and completable. But there's an old saying that a reverse engineer who hires themselves as a beta tester has a fool for a client, so don't take our word for it!
Help us test the games by grabbing a daily build. Read through our testing guidelines. And please take some screenshots along the way. The wiki page for the game explains which files are needed and how to extract them.
If you encounter any unexpected treachery, such as game-breaking bugs or a revision of the game which does not open in ScummVM, please report it on our issue tracker following our bug submission guidelines.

articles.description:
The ScummVM Team is pleased to announce that Amerzone: The Explorer’s Legacy, The Cameron Files: The Secret at Loch Ness, and The Messenger / Louvre: The Final Curse are ready for public testing!
In Amerzone: The Explorer’s Legacy, an old explorer’s final wish sends a young journalist to a hidden land with some precious cargo: the stolen egg of the legendary White Birds. Sail, drive, and puzzle your way through Benoît Sokal’s world of strange wildlife, rusting machinery, and forgotten history.
Loch Ness takes private investigator Alan P. Cameron to the Scottish Highlands, where ghostly apparitions trouble Devil’s Ridge Manor—and his client has vanished. Search for clues, uncover a secret laboratory, and keep an eye on the loch. Some mysteries lurk beneath the surface.
In The Messenger/ Louvre: The Final Curse, agent Morgane Sinclair must recover four dangerous artefacts before the Black Templars can unleash their power. Travel through different eras of the Louvre’s history, mixing modern gadgets with ancient magic. This museum visit comes with considerably more at stake than the admission fee.
All three games run on the PhoenixVR engine, also used by Dracula: Resurrection and Dracula 2: The Last Sanctuary.
Please note that only the Windows versions of these games are supported. The Macintosh and PSX versions use a different engine.
To join the testing, grab a recent daily development build and your original game data files. Report any bugs on our issue tracker, including your ScummVM version, game edition and language, and steps to reproduce the problem.
Mind the egg, watch the water, and try not to end the world. Happy testing!
>

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (bluegr)
articles.description:
Grab your magnifying glass and pack your bags, because Nancy is back on the road! We are pleased to announce that ScummVM now supports four more titles from the Nancy Drew adventure game series, taking the famous detective from a charming 1930s country inn all the way to the volcanic slopes of Hawaii.
In Nancy Drew: Secret of the Old Clock, Nancy visits the Lilac Inn, run by 17-year-old Emily Crandall. A kindly neighbor promised Emily his estate, but when he dies, his will leaves everything to someone else! Meanwhile, objects vanish and reappear, and whispers echo through the empty halls of the inn.
In Nancy Drew: Last Train to Blue Moon Canyon, Nancy and the Hardy Boys join socialite Lori Girard on a train trip to solve a century-old mystery: the disappearance of the train's original owner, Jake Hurley, rumored to have found a fabulous gold mine. But as soon as the journey begins, Lori herself vanishes...
In Nancy Drew: Danger by Design, Nancy goes undercover in Paris as an assistant to Minette, a couture fashion designer who has been throwing tantrums, firing her staff, and refusing to be seen without a mask covering her face. What is she hiding?
In Nancy Drew: The Creature of Kapu Cave, Nancy arrives in Hawaii to assist entomologist Dr. Quigley Kim, only to find her camp ravaged and the doctor missing. Locals whisper that a legendary creature has awoken to prowl the island, and it's up to Nancy and the Hardy Boys to team up and crack the case.
As usual, you will need the original game data files to play these games. The games are available for purchase through HeR Interactive's website or Steam. To play them with ScummVM, you will need a daily development build. If you encounter any issues, please submit a bug report to our issue tracker, following our bug submission guidelines.
The case files are open, and the clues are waiting. Happy investigating!
>

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (neuromancer)
articles.description:
The ScummVM Team is pleased to announce that Eagle Eye Mysteries and Eagle Eye Mysteries in London are ready for public testing!
In each case, you accompany either Jake or Jennifer Eagle, the teenage twin detectives behind the Eagle Eye Detective Agency. Visit locations throughout Richview, question suspects, spot the details that don't quite fit, and record every clue in TRAVIS (Text Retrieval And Video Input System). Follow the evidence, identify the culprit, and solve the mystery. As you progress, cases become increasingly challenging, and each one can be replayed with a different outcome. 
In the sequel, the twins cross the Atlantic, leaving Richview behind for the streets of London and a fresh collection of increasingly difficult mysteries. The new cases revolve around a mysterious thief known as Macavity, whom you'll need to unmask before returning home.
Published by EA*Kids and developed by Stormfront Studios, the Eagle Eye games sit in that rare corner of educational software that took its own genre seriously: a real deduction game, with suspects who lie, clues that only matter in hindsight, and mysteries that expect you to keep notes. Each case is self-contained, and there are plenty of them.
For this testing period, ScummVM supports the Eagle Eye Mysteries DOS releases, in English and Spanish, and the Macintosh release and the Eagle Eye Mysteries in London DOS release. The Macintosh version of Eagle Eye Mysteries in London is still under development and is not part of this testing round.
As usual, you will need the original game data files to play. To join the test, grab a recent daily development build, add your game directory to ScummVM, and play through the games. Please report any problems you encounter on our issue tracker, following our bug submission guidelines. Screenshots and saved games demonstrating an issue are always helpful.
The case files are open. Good luck, detective.
>

articles.description: Především: Všechny trailery a jiné propagační materiály zásadním způsobem lžou o tom, co je tenhle film zač (včetně jeho žánru) a jaká je jeho zápletka. Tom Cruise v něm například NEHRAJE miliardáře jménem Digger, John Goodman NEHRAJE prezidenta a v průběhu filmu nezačne žádná environmentální katastrofa. Film je o podobných věcech, ale je o nich jiným, zajímavějším způsobem, než se zdá z jeho propagace. Následkem toho na něj do kina nepůjdou ti diváci, kterým by se mohl líbit, a naopak. Velmi jsem ocenil, že se nějakým bizarním způsobem podařilo natočit takhle okrajový artfilm s tak obrovským rozpočtem, ale film je bohužel příliš dlouhý a ty extrémně originální a zajímavé scény jsou prokládány desítkami minut něčeho, co je velmi předvídatelné. (Ilča 60 %)

It was discovered that libXpm did not correctly handle XPM images with
zero-dimension values. A local attacker could possibly use this issue to
cause libXpm to use excessive resources, leading to a denial of service.
articles.title: USN-8862-1: libXpm vulnerability

articles.description:
It was discovered that OpenSSL had an inefficient algorithm in its QUIC
stream reassembly implementation. A remote attacker could possibly use this
issue to cause OpenSSL to use excessive CPU resources, leading to a denial
of service. (CVE-2026-42772)

It was discovered that OpenSSL did not properly limit memory allocated for
QUIC packet buffers. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to
cause OpenSSL to use excessive memory resources, leading to a denial of
service. (CVE-2026-54873)
articles.title: USN-8861-1: OpenSSL vulnerabilities

articles.description:
It was discovered that OpenStack Designate did not properly validate
overlapping zones under certain circumstances. An authenticated user could
possibly use this issue to redirect DNS traffic to attacker-controlled
systems or cause a denial of service.
articles.title: USN-8860-1: OpenStack Designate vulnerability

articles.description:
It was discovered that KCoreAddons incorrectly handled shell argument
quoting in KShell::quoteArgs. The parsing did not adequately handle shell
metacharacters, which could lead to a shell escape. An attacker could
possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary commands in applications that
relied on this method to handle user input.
articles.title: USN-8857-1: KCoreAddons vulnerability

articles.description:
It was discovered that Authen::SASL, a Perl authentication library, did
not properly validate login attempts. An attacker could possibly use
this issue to gain unauthorized access.
articles.title: USN-8858-1: Authen::SASL vulnerability
